riskNotes.note: Agent-supplied `config` with an absolute-path `extends` executed arbitrary JS in 0.1.3; fixed in 0.1.4. Verified by execution (lint_solidity, absolute path) and at source (array, solhint:../, plugins, fix_solidity). Unchanged in 0.1.7.
Linting, or reading the config with get_config, runs that repository's own Solhint plugins and JS config, the same trust as running `npx solhint` there. Not safe for untrusted repositories.

Run health (C4) resolved in 0.1.7: a plugin that fails to load or an unknown rule id is reported as a "⚠️ This run was degraded" banner naming each problem, above the findings, also with FORCE_COLOR set; get_config no longer claims the config is sound. A degraded run is not isError (by design: findings from the rules that did load stay usable), so the agent must read the banner. Verified by execution: lint-stage cases 21/21 (kit PR #27, Eval run 40075075328).
